Fixed the actual algorithms-side issue in SnapshotViewer by cloning loaded snapshot/theKit/materialized/VCS DTOs before storing them in React state so manual refreshes always produce a fresh state reference and rerender after transaction undo. Added embedded Vitest coverage in SnapshotViewer and validated it with a focused jsdom Vitest run.
